purpose: Reconcile seven named skip-decoder ledger IDs without treating status claims or parameter settings as seven new experiments. Reproduce available finite controls before any manuscript inference.

ledger_ids.B-22: Same recovered Campaign XVIII executable source as J-01; inventory branch coverage rather than counting as a distinct test.
ledger_ids.J-01: Duplicate source-recovery status claim with B-22. Campaign XVIII contains multiple methods; this cohort does not rerun its full corpus.
ledger_ids.I1-04: The 26 saved-tail fits are already exactly replayed in round19-decoder-null-bars. The upstream 34,000 decoder rows were not freshly generated there.
ledger_ids.R20-HITFN-RECOVERY-GATE: Run original deterministic fake/real planted guard and source tests; measure oracle-free self-consistency separately from true index recovery.
ledger_ids.R20-P3-PANELMAX-SEEDPRIOR-DRIFT: Run source seed-prior exact roundtrip and finite calibration/plant controls where dependencies are available. Do not count prior-ordering as a cipher search.
ledger_ids.R21-L5-REDTEAM-SEAL: Run source deterministic leaky-proxy positive gate and full 45+45+10 fold-seal audit if available; failed catch blocks automatic certification, not all decoder hypotheses.
ledger_ids.R24-C2-EXT-SKIP-GENERATORS: Run seven-axis source plants first; the 113,432-key target sweep remains blocked by exact Welsh/panel dependencies. Do not substitute inputs or treat source-reported zero hits as a fresh replay.

execution_order: Verify source revision, file hashes and required local inputs; execute no more than two independent source processes concurrently.

Run source HITFN guard and tests, P3 seed-prior roundtrip, L5 red-team, and C2-EXT seven-axis controls with original fixed parameters. Keep outputs in an isolated copied source tree, never overwrite pinned source outputs.

Compare fresh structured outputs to pinned archived outputs by fields, distinguishing timing/serialization differences from numerical differences; independently check hit clauses, fold catch, and control recovery where possible.
Only if a source control passes, describe the exact measured control scope. No manuscript negative claim and no C2-EXT target replay without exact missing inputs.

predeclared_gates.hitfn: Fake clears score bar but fails true and oracle-free recovery; real clears both and is accepted. A decoder self-consistency value alone is not plaintext accuracy.
predeclared_gates.l5: Known leaky single-cut proxy must be caught below 0.90 on fresh 45. Candidate fold seal must reach at least 0.90 catch with at most 0.10 false-reject on genuine panel to enable automatic certification.
predeclared_gates.c2_ext: For each generator/plant pair, modeled decoder median true-index recovery at least 0.90 and rigid beam below 0.90 over seven source seeds. A passing plant alone cannot validate the original target sweep or null bar.

limits: Source P3 panel-max calibration uses previously generated null cells; a successful build does not freshly reproduce the million-draw null.
Source red-team samples are finite fixed-seed populations; no universal seal impossibility follows.
Source claim that LP2 doublet behavior identifies a unique key-skip mechanism is not assumed here.
C2-EXT Welsh corpus and I2 panel dependency are not replaced with alternatives.
